card.name: Ending of lactic acidosis
card.fires_on: The final piece of the word "acidosis" in the phrase "lactic acidosis", in metformin labeling. It fires on both the capitalized warning heading and the lowercase running text.

modes.label: Boxed warning heading
modes.description: Capitalized ACIDOSIS ending the boxed warning title.
modes.example: WARNING: LACTIC ACIDOS<<IS>> See full prescribing information for complete boxed warning

modes.label: Running text
modes.description: Lowercase acidosis ending in a sentence about metformin-associated cases.
modes.example: Several of the postmarketing cases of metformin-associated lactic acid<<osis>> occurred in the setting of acute congestive
